_comment: Shared glossary of module-domain texts from the ps-module base template and the feature recipes, translated into every language of languages.json except the source (en). 'ps-module translations fill' copies an entry into a module catalogue when the same English text is missing there. Only add generic texts (used by many modules), translated into every language.
